atoms.text: Bonnie now wants to take you around Edinburgh to end the tour. Will you go around Edinburgh with her?

instruction.text: Select Edinburgh on the map to return there.
Bonnie wants to know if you recognise Edinburgh’s famous landmarks. Select the correct image.

hint.text: A landmark is a building or place that is easily recognisable. For example, it could be a huge tower, a statue or a mountain.
hint.label: Landmark

feedback.wrong: This is the Taj Mahal in India.
feedback.correct: Edinburgh Castle can be found on top of Castle Rock. It has served as a home for royalty and as a military fort for hundreds of years.

feedback.wrong: This is Uluru; a famous rock in Australia.
feedback.correct: Balmoral Hotel is easily recognisable by its clock tower. The clock is set 3 minutes fast to help people catch their trains!

feedback.wrong: This is Times Square in New York, USA.
feedback.correct: Victoria Street is an old street known for its unusual, curved shape and lots of charming shops.

atoms.a: “What is the name of the beach in Edinburgh?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f10'>What is the name of the beach in Edinburgh?</voice>

atoms.a: “Did you know there is an ancient volcano in Edinburgh? Do you know its name?”
atoms.sound: ssml:<voice voiceLang='en' voice='f10'>Did you know there is an ancient volcano in Edinburgh? Do you know its name?</voice>

feedback.end: Arthur’s Seat is about 250m tall. It’s a great climb if you want a beautiful view of the city!
